about.lead: I am interested in building technology that moves beyond experimentation and creates practical value.
paragraphs: My journey spans applied AI, machine learning, software engineering, and research. I enjoy exploring difficult technical problems, understanding their underlying structure, and developing systems that connect intelligent capabilities with real-world needs.
For me, engineering is not simply about making something work. It is about understanding why it matters, how it should work, and how to make it reliable.

impactThemes.title: Bridging Research and Production
impactThemes.statement: Turning research concepts and emerging AI techniques into practical engineering solutions.
impactThemes.detail: Bridging the gap between empirical experimentation and production reality by designing evaluation pipelines, reliability guardrails, and deterministic validation mechanisms.

impactThemes.title: Engineering Beyond Models
impactThemes.statement: Working across backend systems, APIs, databases, integrations, and application architecture.
impactThemes.detail: Ensuring intelligent algorithms sit on top of resilient infrastructure: high-concurrency microservices, asynchronous message queues, clean schema design, and deployment automation.

impactThemes.title: Exploring Multilingual Intelligence
impactThemes.statement: Contributing to research involving multilingual and cross-lingual AI, including Bangla and Portuguese language contexts.
impactThemes.detail: Collaborating across international research lab boundaries with the University of Porto to evaluate cross-lingual semantic representations and comparative statistical benchmarks.

impactThemes.title: Connecting Technology With Real-World Needs
impactThemes.statement: Approaching engineering challenges with an understanding of users, workflows, and practical constraints.
impactThemes.detail: Designing offline-first mobile sync tools for rural agricultural field workers, automating high-throughput document verification, and reducing friction in real-world user operations.

impactThemes.title: Collaborative Innovation
impactThemes.statement: Working across research, engineering, and product-oriented environments to explore and develop solutions.
impactThemes.detail: Participating in venture acceleration programs, student leadership governance, and technical advisory to align engineering rigor with strategic value.
